name: library-manifest-format-stable
body: library.yaml declares `format: 1`. The named definitions (`groups:`, `field_sets:`, `types:`) and the schema extensions (the inline `record` list-item type, `nullable`, `coerce`, `max_items_from`/`min_items_from`, the `image` field's `roots`/`dir`/`extensions`, the `enum` field's `variants_from` and top-level `internal`) are part of format 1 and do not change it; a `library.yaml` declaring any other format is an unsupported library format.
